items.text: Abeemilisi babandu basanjila Yesu
Haho olwa Yesu yali namalile okhuboola amakhuwa ako kosi, yasunjila abeechibe ari
Mumanyile mbu olunyuma lwetsindaalo tsibili Pasaka yakhabeho, ne Omwana wOmundu yeetsa okhuhaanwa mbu abambwe.
Mana abakhulundu babakuhani nende abakofu babandu nibakhung'aanila halala halwanyi wOmukuhani Omukhulundu, owalangwa mbu Kayafa,
nibasanjila halala okhukasia shinga olwa bamuhamba Yesu mubuchesichesi nibamwira.
Ne basunga bari Khuleshe okhukhola mundaalo tsielisabo; indiri yakhabuukha mubandu.
Yesu yabashilwa amafura eBetsania
Ne olwa Yesu yali nali eBetsania, munzu yaSimoni owobuchele,
omukhasi undi namwitsila nali nende ichupa yamafura kobukusi obutinyu muno, nakatsukha khumurwekwe olwa yali niyeekhaale naliitsanga.
Ne olwa abeechi balola bario, basinyikha, bari Kasasiibwe butswa kario mbushi?
Shichila amafura kano kakhakusiibwe obukusi obunji, nabwo nibukabilwa abamanani.
Ne Yesu yalola ario, nabareeba mbu Mumunyasinjia omukhasi oyo mbushi? Okhuba yakholeele omulimo omulayi.
Okhuba abamanani mubeetsanga ninabo tsindaalo tsiosi; ne isie shimuli ninasi tsindaalo tsiosi ta.
Shichila olwa atsushiiliile omubili kwanje amafura kano, akholile okhungasilia okhuyabilwa khwanje.
Emusunjila toto, mbu buli hosi aha Amakhuwa Amalayi kano kaleelwatsungwa mushialo shiosi, akeenako aka omukhasi uno akholile nako kalarumbulungwa, kabe eshiitsuliloshie.
Yuda yafuchilila okhukhoba Yesu
Mana mulala khwIkhumi-nababili abo, owalangwa mbu Yuda Isikariote, yatsia ewabakhulundu babakuhani,
nareeba ari Nishiina eshia mwakhanyala okhumba, mana ndalamuhaana mumakhono keenywe? Nabo nibamuchelela tsifeetsa amakhumi kataru.
Nokhurula habwenaho yakhaaba obwiyangu okhumuhaana mumakhono kwabwe.
Yesu yalia Ipasaka halala nabeechibe
Haho khunyanga yambeli yemikaate echibulamwo amamela, abeechi abo nibamutsiila Yesu, nibamureeba bari Hali heena aha wenya khukhukasilie aha noliile Pasaka?
Naye naboola mbu Mutsie mwitookho, ewomundu wane, nimumusunjila muri Omwechesia aboola mbu lnduukho yanje yili okhuula; nasi enzitsa okhukholela Pasaka munzuyo halala nende abeechi banje.
Abeechi abo nibakhola shinga Yesu olwa yali nababiilile; nibakasia Pasaka.
Nolwa bwoola mungoloobe, yali niyeekhaale naliitsanga halala nende abeechi abo ekhumi-nababili;
nolwa bali nibaliitsanga yaboola mbu Emuboolela toto mbu mulala khwinywe yeetsa okhukhoba.
Nibabeelela muno, nibachaaka okhumureeba buli mulala, bari Omwami, nisie noho?
Nakalusia, nasunga ari Outonjile omukhonokwe ninasi halala mulukaye, omwenoyo yeetsa okhukhoba.
Omwana wOmundu yeenyokha shinga olwa kamuhandiichilwa; ne wowe khumundu oyo oumukhoba Omwana wOmundu Omundu oyo alabula okhwibulwa ta, khane bwakhabeele obulayi khuye.
Naye Yuda, owamukhoba, yakalusia nareeba mbu Nisie, Rabi? Naye namusunjila ari Nolwa oboolile.
Okhusimikha khweLisabo liOmwami
Nolwa bali nibaliitsanga Yesu yabukula omukaate nakusabila ikhabi, nakusonyola, nabaheelesia abeechi abo, nasunga ari Bukule, mulie; kuno nomubili kwanje.
Nabukula eshikombe, nakhupa mbu Orio, nabaheelesia, nasunga ari Nywekhwo mwesi;
okhuba kano namabanga kanje akeIndakano, akeebeenela abandu abanji khulwa okhuleshelwa khwebionoono.
Ne emuboolela mbu okhurula olwa leelo shindalanywakhwo khubiamo bino biemitsabibu ta, okhuula khunyanga yilia olwa ndalanywakhwo obuyia nineenywe halala mubwami bwaPapa.
Yesu yaboola khale aka Petero okhumwambakhana
Nolwa bali nibamalile okhwimba olwimbo, barula nibatsia ebunashikulu shiEmitseituni.
Mana Yesu nababoolela, ari Inywe mwesi namwisichirasibwe khulwanje eshilo shino; shichila kahandiikwa mbu Ndalamukhupa omwayi, nako amakondi akomwitulilie kalasalaana.
Ne olwa ndakhabe nimalile okhulamusibwa, ndakhamuranjilile okhutsia eGalilaya.
Naye Petero yakalusia namusunjila ari Bosi nibaba nibeesichirasibwa khwiwe, nasi shindaleesichirasibwa ta.
Yesu namusunjila ari Ekhuboolela toto, mbu eshilo shino, itaywa niyirashialakula ta, olandiyambakhana khataru.
Petero namuboolela ari Kata nimba nikhoyile okhufwa ninawe, nasi shinekhwiyambakhanekhwo ta. Khandi nilwo olwa abeechi bosi baboola.
Yesu yasabila eGetsesemane
Mana Yesu niyoola ninabo halala habundu ahalangwa mbu Getsesemane, nasunjila abeechibe ari Mwikhale hano, nishitsia halia okhusaaya.
Natsia nende Petero nende abaana abo babili baZebedayo, nachaaka okhuba neshibeela mumwoyo, nasitohelwa okhushila.
Mana nabasunjila ari Omwoyo kwanje kuli neshibeela eshinji; shienya okhunzira; mulinde hano, nimuba meeso halala ninasi.
Natsiakhwo imbeli hatiiti, niyeekhupa hasi mafumama nasaaya, naboola mbu E Papa, nikaba nikanyalikha, eshikombe shino shimbirekhwo; nebutswa karaba aka enzenya isie ta, habula aka iwe wenya.
Nabeetsela abeechi abo, nabanyoola nibali mundoolo, nasunjila Petero ari Mbula, shimwakhanyalile okhuba meeso ninasi isaa ndala ta?
Mube meeso, nimusaaya mbu muleshe okhwinjila mukhuteemwa; omwoyo nomwangu okhwiyama, ne omubili nomutofu.
Khandi natsia olwakhabili, nasaaya, naboola ari E Papa, shino nishiba nishiranyala okhubira, nimba nindashinywa ta, kho aka wenya keekhole.
Niyeetsa khandi nabanyoola nibali mundoolo, shichila tsimoni tsiabwe tsiali nitsisitoohe.
Khandi nabalekha ario, natsia, nasaaya olwakhataru, naboola khandi amakhuwa amalala akeenako.
Mana niyeetsela abeechi abo, nabasunjila mbu Kho mushikona bukona nimuhuluukha, noho? Iole, eshise bulaano shili okhuula, naye Omwana wOmundu akhobilwe mumakhono kaboonooni.
Buushe, khutsie; lole, ali ahambi ou'khoba.
Yesu yakhobwa, nahambwa
Ne olwa yali nashisunga, lola, Yuda niyeetsa, mulala khwIkhumi-nababili abo, nali nende omukanda omukhongo kwabetsinganga nende tsindabushi, abarula khubakhulundu babakuhani nende abakofu babandu.
Ne omwenoyo owamukhoba yabamanyia eshilolelo, nasunga mbu Owa nenzunzuune, neniye; mumuhambe.
Habwenaho niyeetsa ewa Yesu yali, nasunga mbu Mulembe, Rabi; namutsunzuuna muno.
Yesu nasunga mbu Owashianje, khola elia witsile okhukhola. Mana nibeetsa, nibamukwakhwo Yesu, nihamutiila.
Ne lola, oundi khubali nende Yesu yayila omukhono natsomola olukangalwe nakhupa omusumba womukuhani omukhulundu namurema eshirwi.
Mana Yesu namusunjila ari Kalusia olukangalwo aha lubeetsanga; shichila bosi abachinga olukanga balifwa khulwa olukanga.
Kata okaala mbu shinyala okhusaaya Papa, naye kata bulaano buno alarumila abamalaika abashila amahe ekhumi nakabili?
Nebutswa amahandiiko kakhoosibwa karie, mbu nolwa kakhoyile okhwikhola?

Habwenaho Yesu yasunjila abemikanda ari Murulile nende tsinganga netsindabushi okhundiila, shinga abeetsela omunuuli? Ndeekhalanga nineenywe halala muhekalu khatsotselo, ninzechesinjia, nimurambamba ta.
Ne kano kosi keekhola mbu mana amahandiiko kabanabii koosibwe. Mana abeechi bosi nibamulekha nibeelukha.
Okhuyaasibwa khwa Yesu
Nabo abali nibamutiilile Yesu nibamuyila ewaKayafa Omukuhani Omukhulundu, ewa abahandiichi nende abakofu bali nibakhung'aaniile halala.
Ne Petero yali ehalekhwo namulondangakhwo, okhuula mulwanyi IwOmukuhani Omukhulundu, niyeenjilamwo, niyeekhala halala nende abakhalabani, mbu alole akeshihesi.
Abakhulundu babakuhani nende abeshiina bosi nibakhaaba oburumbusi bwobubeeyi khuYesu mbu bamwire;
ne shibabunyoola ta, kata abarumbusi bobubeeyi abanji olwa beetsa. Ne olunyumakhwo babili nibeetsa,
nibaboola bari Omundu uno yasunga mbu Enyala okhulikulula ihekalu yaNyasaye ninjiumbashila khundaalo tsitaru.
Mana Omukuhani Omukhulundu nasinjila namureeba ari Shiokalusia likhuwa ta? Namakhuwa shiina aka bano barumbulanga khwiwe?
Naye Yesu naholeela butswa. Omukuhani Omukhulundu namusunjila mbu Ekhutsubia, muliira liaNyasaye oubeetsangaho mwoyo, okhuboolele noba noli iwe Kristo watsana, Omwana waNyasaye.
Yesu namukalusia ari Nolwa oboolile iwe; nebutswa emusunjila, mbu olunyuma mulalola Omwana wOmundu niyeekhaale khumukhono musaatsa kwObunyali obwo, niyeetsanga khumaleesi akomwikulu.
Mana Omukuhani Omukhulundu narandula ebiifwalobie, naboola mbu Aboolile akobwichelasi nende Nyasaye; khushikhaaba abaloli bandi mbushi? Lole, bulaano muhuliile obwichelasi bwene;
muluutsi murie? Nibakalusia, nibaboola mbu Akwanile okhufwa.
Mana nibachaaka okhumunyilikhakhwo amare mumoni, nibamuupa ebifuusi, abandi nibamupaama tsikhofi,
nibasunga bari Okhulakulile, iwe Kristo; oukhuupile niwina?
Petero yamwambakhana Yesu
Naye Petero yali niyeekhaale elwanyi, mulwanyi; omukhaana undi natsia ewa yali, nasunga mbu Wesi wabeele nende Yesu omuGalilaya oyo.
Naye niyeeyambakhana imbeli wabo bosi, ari Shimanyile aka osunganga ta.
Ne olwa yali narulile natsiile hashilibwa, omukhaana undi namulola, nabasunjila abali nibaliho, ari Omusaatsa uno yesi yabeele halala nende Yesu omuNazareti.
Naye niyeeyambakhana khandi, nende eshiitsubo, ari Shimumanyile omundu oyo ta.
Nolunyumakhwo abo abali nibasinjiileho nibeetsa nibasunjila Petero bari Toto mwene, wesi shiochweya okhuba mulala khubo ta; shichila okhuboolakhwo khukhubuulanga.
Mana nachaaka okhwifuuha niyeetsuba, ari Shimumanyile omundu oyo ta. Habwenaho itaywa niyilakula.
Mana Petero niyeetsulila likhuwa elia Yesu yali namusunjiile, mbu Itaywa niyirashialakula ta, naundiyambakhane okhuula khataru. Narula nalila bululu.
